'''Ken Rose''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 2000 Rochester tournament (21 October)]] on 21 October 2000 with New school Throne Room, according to R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1386">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-rochester-ny-10-21-2000d1386/ rochester-ny-10-21-2000], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-rochester-ny-10-21-2000d1386/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
